description: This file implements server-side logic for the 'SetExam' page of an online examination system. It handles course selection, question addition, exam setup, and navigation between different pages using ASP.NET Web Forms event handlers. The code interacts with an SQL database to store question and exam details, and contains UI event handlers for buttons and dropdowns.

classes.name: SetExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the 'SetExam' ASP.NET page, managing course selection, question and exam setup, and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles initial page load; currently contains commented-out code for session management.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on the selected semester, adding course options dynamically.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new MCQ question to the database and updates the question number.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Creates a new exam entry in the database for the selected course.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates course options based on selected semester.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates question number based on selected course.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page.
